required_signal_interface: The strict monitored payoff needs each date's exact sum of guarded native stock exponentials, their floor average, a strict H comparison and maximum/AND composition; the Asian strike needs the exact all-stock/date sum, rounded averaging coefficient, strict positive part and already-discounted magnitude. A coherent log-sum-exp or alternative signal must implement these dependencies with normalization, finite native/tie errors, preparation, inverse, comparison and all oracle invocations paid.
